Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologii energetice și Fabricația de echipamente electrice
We are currently searching for a Technical Support Engineer to support our business development Base at Romania . This is for our Smart Home brand IMOU .
 1, Who Are We? 
 IMOU is a global leader in Smart Home segment and we have built a reputation in overseas market as the go to vendor for Smart Security & Smart Home.
 Set up as a subsidiary of Dahua Group which is the second largest surveillance & security manufacturer in the world, IMOU has been established to make smart home security & technology much easier to operate/use. IMOU’s product lines include Smart Security, Smart Lock, Smart Energy/Lighting, IOT, Smart Robotics, Storage & Cloud.
 Our mission is to make Smart Home more affordable, effortless to use & easily accessible to our customers.
 Job Description 
 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Online Technical Q&A and Remote Support
 Serve distributors, resellers and installers via Facebook, phone and chat apps; resolve installation, connectivity, video playback and configuration issues remotely; prioritize concurrent requests by urgency and manage customer expectations.
 2. On-site Technical Support and After-sales / RMA
 Resolve technical problems and product quality issues on site; re-diagnose root cause when on-site findings differ from remote assessment; collect evidence, grade cases and drive the RMA process to closure.
 3. Technical Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis
 Apply a four-layer approach covering device, network, installation and usage; handle vague or non-reproducible failures by tracing related layers; stay root-cause-first rather than applying workarounds.
 4. Pre-sales Solution Design and Product Selection
 Recommend models, configurations and network topology for residential, SMB retail and project scenarios; provide technical comparison when customers evaluate multiple brands or solutions.
 5. Training and Partner Enablement (Online and Offline)
 Train the sales team, distributors, resellers, installers and promoters; cover new product launches, new customer development and quarterly regular training; make complex technology usable for non-technical audiences.
 6. Localization and Translation
 Convert HQ English materials into local-language FAQs, quick installation manuals and operation videos; optimize structure and workflow so installers can use them directly.
 7. Product Promotion and Event Technical Presentation
 Support annual customer meetings, new product launches and industry exhibitions; handle product presentation, technical solution introduction and sample booth setting.
 8. Local Market Insight and Sales Collaboration
 Track mainstream local products, solutions and customer segments; assess competitor brands; liaise with distributors and support the sales team on PSI management with two-way information flow.
 9. Partner App Operation and Knowledge Accumulation
 Update product material and drive installer adoption of the Partner App for self-service query and ticket submission; turn recurring issues into standardized FAQs and knowledge base, and feed improvements back to the product team.
 JOB REQUIREMENTS 
 1. 3+ years in a technical support role with deep knowledge of CCTV / security products; able to independently resolve device, network, installation and usage issues.
 2. Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 3. Fluent English, plus working proficiency in the local language of the assigned market.
 4. Demonstrated deliverables: a complete troubleshooting cycle from diagnosis to closure, training delivery or knowledge material development, and handling of multiple concurrent customer requests with defined priorities.
 5. Customer-oriented and patient with escalated customers; willing to travel frequently and respond to customers at short notice.
6. Preferred: pre-sales solution design or after-sales system building experience; overseas channel support experience; familiarity with ONVIF, H.264/H.265 and IP networking.
